Metadata.siteDescription: FlakeForge is a product studio. We build web apps, mobile apps, and Telegram bots, and publish our own tools as open source.

home.title: FlakeForge: product studio and open source
home.description: We build web apps, mobile apps, and Telegram bots for clients, and publish the tools we make along the way on GitHub.

work.title: Work
work.description: Client projects and our own products, with case studies and links to the source code.

services.title: Services
services.description: Web development, mobile apps, and Telegram bots and Mini Apps. What each service includes and how a project runs.

about.title: About
about.description: Who we are, how we like to work, and why we publish our tools as open source.

blog.description: Notes on how we build things: tools, technical decisions, and problems we ran into.

contact.title: Start a project
contact.description: Tell us what you want to build. We reply by email or Telegram.

web.title: Web development
web.summary: Sites, web apps, and internal tools, built with Next.js and TypeScript.
points: Speed, accessibility, and SEO fixes on sites you already have

mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.summary: iOS and Android apps for products that people use on their phones every day.
points: One shared codebase where the product allows it

telegram.title: Telegram bots and Mini Apps
telegram.summary: Bots and Mini Apps for products whose users already spend their day in Telegram.
points: Bots for support, sales, and notifications
Mini Apps with a full web interface inside Telegram
Connections to your backend, CRM, or payment provider

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: We talk through the problem, the people who will use the product, and the limits on time and budget. You get a written scope for the first release.

design.title: Design
design.body: We map the main flows, then design the screens that matter most. You click through a prototype before we write production code.

build.title: Build
build.body: We work in short cycles and deploy to a staging link you can open at any time. Code goes through review before it merges.

launch.title: Launch
launch.body: We ship the first release, watch how people use it, and fix what gets in their way. Then we either keep going with you or hand over the code and docs.

hero.title: Forging ideas <accent>into reality.</accent>
hero.lede: We design and build web apps, mobile apps, and Telegram bots. The tools we make for ourselves go on GitHub.

openSource.title: Built in the open
openSource.body: Our tools and some of our products are public on GitHub. You can read the code before you decide to work with us.

closing.title: Have something to build?
closing.body: Tell us about it. A few lines are enough to start the conversation.

Project.fallbackNotice: This case study has not been translated yet, so you are reading the English version.

WorkPage.title: Work
WorkPage.intro: Client projects and our own products. The code for most of them is public.

ServicesPage.title: Three things, done properly
ServicesPage.intro: We build for the web, for phones, and for Telegram. Every project starts with a short scope and ends with code you can keep working on.

AboutPage.title: We build products for clients and tools for everyone else.
AboutPage.intro: FlakeForge is a product studio. We take on client work in web, mobile, and Telegram, and publish the tools we make along the way as open source.

open.title: Open by default
open.body: If something we build is useful outside one project, we publish it under an open license.

early.title: Ship early
early.body: A small release in front of real users teaches more than a long plan. We get the first version out and improve it from there.

written.title: Write it down
written.body: Scope, decisions, and setup steps go into writing, so the project does not depend on one person's memory.
